verdict.rationale: Docs confirm batch-style operations: querying with a list of query texts returns top-n matches per query (chroma-docs-2), and metadata/full-text filters operate across the whole collection at once (chroma-docs-3/4/22), plus dataset-level bulk operations like forking for versioning/A-B testing (chroma-docs-8/18/26). However, there's no explicit documentation of bulk insert/update/delete APIs (e.g., batch add of thousands of embeddings, bulk delete by filter) in the evidence pack. Missing for 10: explicit bulk insert/update/delete API docs, and independent hands-on confirmation of large-batch throughput/limits.
